Companion Animal Travel Desk incident report

This incident took place at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways during a routine stretch of passenger service, with the usual flow of travelers, carrier checks, and desk notes moving in order. The matter began when a traveler asked for help reconciling a pet booking with a late service change already noted in the desk ledger. The record showed that the animal had been accepted for travel under standard care, and the cabin team was expected to monitor the carrier during flight while the ground team handled careful movement between services.

As the desk review continued, the paperwork was checked against the carrier tags and the traveler documents, and a small mismatch in the service note was found before boarding release. The traveler remained calm while staff explained that the item needed correction so the pet could travel under the right handling note. The carrier was kept in the approved holding area, and the desk team spoke with the ground team to confirm the animal's path through the service point. The note was adjusted in the ledger, and the revised detail was shared with the cabin team so the watch plan would match the actual booking.

The handling steps were completed without strain. Staff kept the traveler informed in plain language, confirmed that the carrier was secure, and made sure the animal did not leave the care area until the record was aligned. The senior coordinator reviewed the file, and the desk aide updated the service log with the corrected entry and the reason for the change. This kept the report consistent with routine practice and gave a clear trail for later review.

For follow-up, the desk will continue to check carrier labels against all service notes before release, with extra care on cases that have recent changes. Staff will also remind travelers that small booking differences are easier to resolve when brought to the desk early. The event was settled in a steady manner, and no further concern was recorded.
